reviews.title: Please make the meditation have a speed setting for fast or slow
reviews.text: I wish that the nighttime meditation had a way to make it play slower or faster lately it’s been way to fast and I can hardly relax or comprehend the prayer before it’s over.. other than that it’s a nice app I appreciate that there is no chat room like the other ones it’s definitely safe for children to have without some stranger being able to contact them for that alone I would rate 5 stars but I would like the meditation to be slower

reviews.title: Bad Options
reviews.text:
There are no other versions of the Bible. The voices are very bad, one called “Bad News.” The devotional said “all means are good to save souls” That is not biblically true. 
I don’t think this is a real app. It really encourages you to allow to be tracked. I’m deleting it after 15 minutes of use.

reviews.title: DO NOT DOWNLOAD
reviews.text: I was excited to get this because im dyslexic and struggle to read the Bible and i used the audio version and it started cursing and calling me slurs and nasty words!! im horrified!!! there needs to be a negative star option.

reviews.title: Not a fan
reviews.text: I’m not a fan of this app. I ended up deleting it to find another one. I couldn’t figure out how to change the version and the reading voice sounded really weird and kind of scary. It just wasn’t for me.
